dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Very high prominence with sharp, distinct white boundaries against dark feather centers on the folded wings.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible as a distinct transition in pattern density; the fine, dense scalloping of the crown transitions to larger, coarser scales on the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-contrast, repetitive scalloped plumage pattern across the entire dorsal surface, consisting of dark grey feather centers and wide, white fringes.
